title: The echo that kept falling
dek: The Little Giant fire, which started in July 2026, burned across forested slopes in central Washington. Smoke hid them from optical satellites. L-band radar saw through it, and inside the mapped perimeter the forest's echo kept falling into October.

radar.explainer: NISAR's L-band radar (24 cm waves) passes through smoke and cloud. Its cross-polarized HV echo comes from branches and trunks, so when fire thins a canopy the HV echo weakens. Averaged over a whole perimeter, that drop stands out from the noise of single pixels.

legend.label: Yellow-green
legend.meaning: Forest: the radar signal scatters around inside the canopy and returns strong in HV.

legend.label: Olive green
legend.meaning: Open rangeland, grass and towns: less canopy, so a weaker HV echo.

legend.label: Dark teal
legend.meaning: Reservoirs and rivers: calm water reflects the radar away, so almost nothing returns.

legend.label: White haze
legend.meaning: Smoke and cloud on the day of the optical scene. The ground under it is hidden.

legend.label: Brown
legend.meaning: Burned ground after the fire, visible once the smoke cleared.

legend.label: Olive and tan
legend.meaning: Dry forest and rangeland in natural colour, before the fire.

beats.headline: Dry forest and hills
beats.body: Forested slopes and ridges in central Washington. This is the summer before the fire, in natural colour.

beats.headline: Smoke hides the ground
beats.body: More than three weeks after the fire was reported, {stat:smoke_cloud_pct} of this optical scene is flagged as smoke or cloud. Drag the divider: the radar view of the same land, through the haze.

beats.headline: The echo inside the perimeter
beats.body: Before and after, the same land. Inside the mapped perimeter, the HV echo fell by {stat:burn_hv_drop_db} relative to the forest around it.

beats.headline: Bigger than chance
beats.body: Squares moved onto unburned land in this scene change by about {stat:placebo_sd_db} either way. The fire's drop is far outside that spread. The perimeter itself covers {stat:burned_ha}. Within two kilometres of it stand {stat:impact_buildings_near} mapped buildings.

beats.headline: Help burned land recover
beats.body: After a fire this size, slopes need replanting and protection from erosion before the rains. Two organizations work on forest and landscape restoration in the United States.

landmarks.label: Inside the burn
landmarks.note: The burn's echo compared with the land around it: median HV inside the Little Giant perimeter minus median HV in the ring around it, averaged over the passes before and after the fire. The gap narrowed.

landmarks.label: Land around the burn
landmarks.note: Unburned land in the ring the burn is compared with. Rain and season move this land's echo and the burn's together, so the comparison cancels them.

action.headline: Help burned land recover
action.body: The mapped perimeter of the Little Giant fire encloses {stat:burned_ha} of Washington. These organizations work on restoring forests and landscapes.

local.headline: Act where you live
local.body: Wildfire seasons are getting longer across western North America. Preparing where you live helps firefighters and neighbours.
steps: Learn your local wildfire or emergency alert system and sign up for it.
Clear dry material within a few metres of buildings, following your local FireSmart or Firewise guidance.
Support forest restoration after fires, through the organizations on the first tab.

burn_hv_drop_db.label: HV drop inside the perimeter, relative to the forest around it
burn_hv_drop_db.method: NISAR NISAR_L2_GCOV_PROVISIONAL_V1. Median HV inside the Little Giant perimeter minus median HV of a ring of forest 0.5 to 2.4 km outside it, averaged over the 3 passes before 2026-07-16 and the 2 passes after 2026-09-28; the stat is the fall in that gap.

placebo_sd_db.label: Spread of the same measure where nothing burned
placebo_sd_db.method: Standard deviation over 300 squares of one sixth the perimeter's area moved onto unburned forest in the same scene; mean +0.00 dB, 0.0% as low as the fire.

burned_ha.label: Area inside the mapped perimeter
burned_ha.method: NIFC interagency perimeter of Little Giant, mapped 2026-09-28. Not a NISAR measurement.

n_dates.label: Radar dates
n_dates.method: NISAR acquisition dates in the series.

smoke_cloud_pct.label: Optical scene blocked by smoke or cloud
smoke_cloud_pct.method: Share of pixels Fmask flags as cloud, cloud edge, shadow or snow on the day of the optical scene.

impact_buildings_near.label: Buildings mapped within 2 km of the Little Giant fire perimeter
impact_buildings_near.method: Overture Maps building footprints intersecting a buffer around the footprint.
